{{Quote|Anything a soldier needs and some things he doesn't.|Tash describes his stock.|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Tash''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked selling medium [[Armor/Legends|armor]] in the market section of the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Great Houses of Alderaan|Great]] [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa's]] [[House Organa (estate)|estate]] in the [[Apalis Coast]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. He worked during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], in which he served as a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the military of the Republic-allied House Organa. He had fair skin, [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]], which included a small beard on his chin. While selling his goods from a stall, he wore armor and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tash appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Medium Armor Vendor for Republic players on Alderaan.<ref name="SWTOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Tash was removed from the game along with the rest of the Medium Armor Vendors.<ref name="SWTOR" /> His position is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', a game guide released by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="Explorer">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>
